persons.name: Vāsudeva
persons.evidence: vāsudevo lilekha || ... dātā dadau ravikulodbhavavāsudevaḥ, pustīmimāṃ kulamaṇidvijalakṣmaṇāya

persons.name: Pūrṇasiṃha
persons.evidence: svakulakamalabhānuḥ pūrṇasiṃhaś ca prītyā ... vāsudevo lilekha

persons.name: Lakṣmaṇaśarman
persons.evidence: dātā dadau ravikulodbhavavāsudevaḥ, pustīmimāṃ kulamaṇidvijalakṣmaṇāya ... dvijalakṣmaṇākhyo, pādhyāya(śarmaṇa) idaṃ

date.as_written: nidhivasumunivarṣe māghamāse valakṣe śiśirakiraṇaṛkṣe bhānuvāre daśamyāṃ

notes: Chronogram: nidhi (9), vasu (8), muni (7) = NS 789. The scribe Vāsudeva, claiming descent from the solar lineage (ravikulodbhava), gifted the manuscript to Upādhyāya Lakṣmaṇa.
